title: Meetup Alternative for Groups, Events and Activities | Radius
excerpt: Radius is a modern Meetup alternative for local groups, events and activities. Find people with shared interests, join what they are doing nearby, or start your own community.
content_html:
Find your community.

Connect through groups, events and activities.

Post what you're up for

Takes 30 seconds. No commitment required.

Meet others through interests.

Coffee, a run, a bike ride: post it with a time and place. People nearby who share that interest can join you.
